BusinessCriticality.description:
Business criticality of the owning system.

A string enum rather than a bare 1-5 integer so that an unset value is
``unknown`` and visibly so, rather than silently becoming 3 (P3).
BusinessCriticality.title: BusinessCriticality

EvidenceSource.description: Ranked sources for the confidentiality lifetime X.
EvidenceSource.title: EvidenceSource

ExposureLevel.description:
Network reachability of the system holding the artefact.

Drives HNDL urgency: internet-exposed traffic can be recorded today by an
adversary with no access to the network, which is what makes it the
highest-priority confidentiality risk.
ExposureLevel.title: ExposureLevel

Provenance.description: Which tier supplied a single context field, and why (P4).

source_detail.description: Identifier within the tier, e.g. the org preset name or the taint rule that produced the evidence.
source_detail.title: Source Detail

Provenance.title: Provenance

ProvenanceTier.description:
Which tier supplied a context field.

Strict precedence, strongest first. Every resolved context field records its
tier so that no number can be presented without its origin (P4).
ProvenanceTier.title: ProvenanceTier

RetentionBasis.description:
What backs a retention figure.

``regulatory_minimum`` carries an explicit caveat: Indian statutes mandate
retention *minimums*, not confidentiality lifetimes, and the two are not
interchangeable.
RetentionBasis.title: RetentionBasis

RetentionEvidence.description: One piece of evidence for the confidentiality lifetime X.

caveat.description: Printed with the figure wherever it appears. Retention minimums in particular are not confidentiality lifetimes.
caveat.title: Caveat

citation.description: Statute, policy id or profile entry.
citation.title: Citation

RetentionEvidence.title: RetentionEvidence

description:
Resolved business context for one artefact, with per-field provenance.

Created by the context resolver, editable by a user. The ``provenance`` map
is what lets the UI show *where each number came from* (P4, and UI
obligation O2).

provenance.description: field name -> which tier supplied it. Fields absent from this map were never resolved and must render as 'unknown', not as a value with no origin.
provenance.title: Provenance
